name: opinion_vs_direct_reporting
description: Benchmark for verifying coverage type classification distinguishes opinion/editorial content from direct reporting, and that only direct coverage is retained

seed.description: EPA announces new emissions standards for power plants effective 2028

simulated_candidates.title: EPA Announces New Emissions Standards for Power Plants Effective 2028
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: The Environmental Protection Agency announced new emissions standards for power plants that will take effect in 2028, targeting carbon output from coal and natural gas facilities.

simulated_candidates.title: New EPA Rules Require Power Plants to Cut Emissions by 2028
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: The EPA issued sweeping new emissions standards requiring power plants to dramatically reduce carbon emissions by 2028 or face penalties.

simulated_candidates.title: EPA Emissions Standards for Power Plants: What It Means for 2028
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: The EPA announced new emissions standards for power plants effective 2028 that industry experts warn will impact coal-dependent communities across the midwest.

simulated_candidates.title: Opinion: EPA's Power Plant Rules Are Unconstitutional Overreach
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: Opinion: The EPA's new emissions standards for power plants represent an unconstitutional expansion of agency power that will raise energy costs for all Americans by 2028.

simulated_candidates.title: Editorial: EPA Emissions Standards Don't Go Far Enough for 2028
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: Editorial: While the EPA's new emissions standards for power plants are a step forward, the 2028 timeline is far too slow given the urgency of the climate crisis.

simulated_candidates.title: EPA Releases Annual Water Quality Standards Update
simulated_candidates.text_excerpt: The EPA released its annual water quality standards report, addressing lead contamination and PFAS levels across municipal water systems.

expectations.description: The system must retain direct reporting about the event from multiple perspectives and correctly reject opinion/editorial articles as non-direct coverage. Unrelated EPA articles must be rejected via disambiguation.
